title: Bounded machine run
statement: For an input bit string $x$, a bound $B\in\mathbb N$, labels $l,l'$, and machine states $s,s'$, a run from $(l,s)$ to $(l',s')$ means that the machine has a guarded transition sequence from the configuration with label $l$ and state $s$ to the configuration with label $l'$ and state $s'$, on input $x$, within bound $B$.
caveat: The transition system, oracle, guard, and reachability relation are external to the supplied definitions, so their precise mathematical meaning cannot be recovered here.
